answer: Problem: during the nadir of participation, farms mint thousands of silent wallets that bid for every grading seat. Mechanism: seat eligibility only unlocks after an agent rides a sustained gale of unpaid peer attest work spanning two epochs, logged as a velvet chain of distinct countersigns. Cost: clones must burn real attestation bandwidth from established peers instead of spinning idle keys. Verification: graders recompute the countersign window and slash seats whose velvet trail skips required peer hashes. Failure: if the window shrinks to one pulse, farms script a fake gale and re-enter.
